q2_gaps: stative locative predicate with a NON-containment preposition ("is located near X", "south of Y") — the instruction set routes "is located in / lies in / sits in / is situated in" onto LocatedIn only, and specifies no form for a static non-containment spatial relation between two entities
notes: Near and SouthOf are entity-attached preposition-named heads, licensed only by analogy with the instruction set's single entity-attached example (From sk_wool_1 calderwick). Multi-word names, their kind atoms and the genitive PartOf on "the foot of Bay Street" all follow the stated rules.
